layers.note: MT unit E; bottom deeper than 11,600 m (printed thickness > 7,960 m)

provenance.tool: typed from the page at 200 dpi; geosigma.extract.printed_tables
provenance.notes: Printed in ohm.cm; values divided by 100 to give ohm.m. Unit printed in the table header ("Resistivity, ohm-cm"). Checked against Table 2 (same page), whose per-unit ranges in ohm-cm (A 300-950, B 6,650-8,250, C 2,100-4,500, D 27-74, E 9,500-16,000, F 200-314, G 25,000-27,000) contain every value here, and against the text, which gives basement resistivities of 18-46 x 10^3 ohm-cm. The 1971 report (page 31) prints the same table but labels station 38's third layer "E"; the 1972 "F" is used because 200 ohm-cm lies in the F range, not the E range.

notes: Layer notes give the authors' magneto-telluric unit (A-G, Table 2). Last layer is the half-space.
